title.narrative: Towards a sustainable stabilisation in Iraq - Phase III

description.narrative: Contract related to: Towards a sustainable stabilisation in Iraq - Phase III - This measure will have two components, both serving the overarching objective of addressing grievances and supporting the post-Da¿esh stabilisation efforts. The first component will build on the mediation and dialogue achievements from previous IcSP[1] supported initiatives by focusing on inclusive and sustainable dialogue between the Iraqi Government and its citizens and facilitating the return of displaced Iraqis to their homes. The second component will continue efforts to preserve evidence related to Da¿esh-related crimes and atrocities, notably the ongoing efforts of UNITAD to build an accessible, comprehensive evidence base to investigate and prosecute Da¿esh crimes. The assistance will, furthermore, support UNITAD¿s investigation into crimes on the grounds of sexual orientation committed against the lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) community. It will also provide targeted assistance to investigations and domestic legal proceedings against Da¿esh members to new geographic areas that are currently underexplored in addition to answering requests for assistance from third-states, including EU Member States. [1] The Instrument contributing to Stability and Peace
